propositions: The test fixture retried the batched Git resolver up to five times but called the per-event oracle resolve_event_commit only once per equivalence assertion, causing flakiness when the batched side recovered but the oracle returned None on a transient Git read.

Production resolve_event_commit deliberately maps all Git errors, empty results, timeouts, and exceptions to None and must remain fail-closed; the defect is in the test oracle, not production behavior.

A test-local bounded helper _fixture_per_event_commit was added to retry the per-event oracle up to five times, returning only non-None SHAs and raising loud diagnostics with fsck/count-objects evidence on persistent failure.
All batched/per-event exact-equivalence assertions in the fixture module now route through the bounded helper, preserving exact position-to-SHA comparisons without weakening original expectations.
Production source code in src/rebar remains unchanged; resolve_event_commit retains its documented fail-closed contract and production callers are unaffected.
